study_design: Prospective cohort analysis of the NHANES I Epidemiologic Follow-up Study

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Relative to the group with low urinary iodine, the age-adjusted hazard ratio was higher (although marginally insignificant) in the moderate group, hazard ratio 1.33 (95% confidence interval 1.00-1.78), and significantly lower in the high group, 0.71 (0.51-0.99).
